name: Linked List
description: A Linked List is a linear data structure where elements are stored in nodes. Each node contains data and a reference (link) to the next node in the sequence. Unlike arrays, linked lists don't require contiguous memory allocation and allow efficient insertion and deletion at any position.

aiExplanation.content: A Linked List is a fundamental linear data structure consisting of nodes where each node contains data and a pointer to the next node. The reversal operation demonstrates the power of pointer manipulation - by changing the direction of links, we can reverse the entire list in O(n) time with O(1) space complexity. This is more efficient than creating a new reversed list.
